description.en: Reads a button or the touch screen. Buttons: "A", "B", "X", "Y", "L", "R", "DU", "DD", "DL", "DR" (the directional pad), "SELECT", "START"; states "Down" and "On". For "TOUCH" the states are "Down", "On" and "TouchS". By the names, Down is a new press and On a held one. It answers false while the script system's input is not enabled.

true if the button is in that state, false otherwise.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Waiting for A, B or a touch (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut, BtnImageNext)
